view.title: Powder Room — From the Cinema Corridor
view.description: From the cinema corridor, the expanded guest powder suite opens into a shared vanity room with glossy oxblood lacquer, a sculpted black-marble vanity with three basins and a long aged-brass-framed mirror. Four broad fluted opal sconces give soft, warm-neutral light at face height for photographs. A full-length mirror sits in a recessed bay clear of the basins, and Halvard Brekke’s red abstract hangs on the facing wall. Four enclosed WCs are tucked around the return. A separate accessible WC opens off the corridor.

view.title: Powder Room — At Mirror Height
view.description: A mirror-height view of the three-basin black-marble vanity and its four fluted opal lights. The broad face-height light is softer and more neutral than the warm wash on the oxblood lacquer. The mirror reflects Brekke’s red abstract, and a separate full-length portrait mirror sits in the recessed bay beyond the vanity.
